in_hebrew.name: Paddie
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Paddie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Diminutive form of the Irish name Patricius, derived from Latin Patricius meaning 'noble, patrician'. In Ireland, it was common for a diminutive name to be used for a child born into a noble family, but who was not the eldest.
